ana: Heads-up — CI failing when running the embeddings + rerank eval for mamba-small-qat (quantized bring-up). Getting duplicate key errors in MetricCollector.

ana: Error snippet:```
2026-03-19 14:02:11,431 MetricCollector ERROR Duplicate keys for query_id=Q23456 while aggregating topk
File "/opt/eval/harness/runner.py", line 274, in collect
    agg[query_id].extend(cands)
KeyError: 'Q23456'
```

sam: weird — can you paste the exact test config + dataset name?

ana: using mteb-like retrieval split: dev/retrieval/stack-overflow-para, runner config: `rerank.topk=100, seed=42, dedup=true`. Happens only for the quantized artifact, not fp16.

leo: guess: dedup step is a no-op if candidate ids are floats or become non-hashable after quantization cast. but stack traces point at missing init for agg[query_id], not hash error. maybe duplicate query rows in the TSV?

maria: I also noticed we changed NDCG handling last week to support variable K in the metric name ("ndcg@{k}"). If the code uses string parsing + regex we could be accidentally expanding k into a list and summing twice for corner cases when k > num_cands.

kyle: looking at runner code now — `MetricCollector.collect` starts with `if query_id in agg: agg[query_id].extend(cands) else: agg[query_id] = cands`. If `cands` is a generator previously consumed elsewhere it might be empty on first pass and then non-empty on second, leading to weird states. Also the quantized eval path wraps candidates in a lazy map for memory savings.

ana: attaching minimal repro (I removed heavy logs):```
query_id\tcand_id\tscore
Q1\tD1\t0.9
Q1\tD2\t0.8
Q2\tD3\t0.7
Q1\tD1\t0.9  # duplicate row introduced by preproc when vector b64 decode failed
```

eva: ok — two separate bugs: 1) duplicated rows in preproc -> dedup should run before aggregation; 2) MetricCollector mutates shared lists when passed by reference and not copying. Both combined cause the KeyError when the same query_id is processed concurrently.

sam: minimal fix proposal: 1) enforce `dedup_by_id()` as first step in `runner.prepare_inputs`; 2) in MetricCollector.collect, do `agg.setdefault(query_id, []).extend(list(cands))` to avoid generator issues and accidental shared state. 3) clamp k to min(k, len(cands)) in ndcg calc.

kyle: I'll open a tiny patch for collector + clamp. maria can you add a quick unit for the ndcg string parsing edge-case?

maria: yup will add `test_ndcg_parsing_clamp` to eval-harness/tests/metrics_test.py. Will also add a golden TSV that includes duplicate rows to cover preproc.

leo: also there was a dashboard parser change that tries to infer metric names automatically and chokes on `ndcg@all`. We should make the reporting accept `ndcg@\d+` only and normalize to `ndcg@{k}` label. Otherwise the dashboard inflates counts.

devops-bot: CI pipeline (eval-e2e) triggered for branch `fix/ndcg-collector` — build 7821 started.

ana: thanks. once we have a passing CI I want a smoke run comparing mamba-small-qat vs mamba-small-fp16 on retrieval MRR@10 + NDCG@10 and also embeddings cosine AUC on the same suite. Put results into the rerank dashboard under team=eng-ml, env=staging.

kyle: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/459 — includes collector changes + k clamp.

devops-bot: CI build 7821 failed on unit `test_ndcg_parsing_clamp` (flake). Re-ran build 7822.

devops-bot: CI build 7822 passed all tests.

eva: next steps: (1) merge PR after LGTM, (2) add preproc dedup in a follow-up (low-risk), (3) schedule a quick rerun of the mamba quantized job in staging (I'll kick it off).

ana: noted. I'll also add a short note to the onboarding checklist: "run dedupe pre-check on TSVs before quantized bring-up".

sam: nice triage. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ana: marking resolved for now, will follow up with summary in the weekly eval sync.
